answer: Sybil resistance comes from requiring every agent identity to present a fresh, verifiable hardware attestation binding its execution to an approved MRENCLAVE, with platform credentials checked by the verifier. The measurement identifies enclave code, while hardware-backed keys anchor the quote to genuine silicon; duplicating a VM cannot mint those credentials. An attacker must acquire additional attested hardware, raising the cost of multiplying identities from the summit of software convenience toward a costly dawn on the hardware horizon.
